title: Bounded-below derived mates are computed by underived mates and comparison units
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal A',\mathcal B'$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] in a common universe [def-weil-size-convention], with derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and bounded-below categories $D^+(-)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Assume $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal A'$ have enough injectives, meaning that every object embeds into an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Give additive adjunctions $L:\mathcal B\rightleftarrows\mathcal A:R$ and $L':\mathcal B'\rightleftarrows\mathcal A':R'$ with $L,L'$ exact. Let $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B'$ and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A'$ be exact additive functors. Write $C(F)$ for termwise application of an additive functor to bounded-below complexes, $D(F)$ for the descent of an exact functor [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and $Q$ for localization. Use the canonical bounded-below derived adjunctions $D(L)\dashv\mathbf R R$ and $D(L')\dashv\mathbf R R'$, with the right-derived comparison units $\alpha_P:Q C(R)P\to(\mathbf R R)(QP)$ and $\alpha'_{P'}:Q C(R')P'\to(\mathbf R R')(QP')$ [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]. For any natural transformation $\sigma:L'G\to HL$, let $b:GR\to R'H$ be its underived mate and let $b^D:D(G)\mathbf R R\to(\mathbf R R')D(H)$ be the mate of the termwise-derived transformation $D(\sigma):D(L')D(G)\to D(H)D(L)$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Then for every bounded-below complex $P$ of $\mathcal A$, under the canonical exact-functor localization identifications,
$$b^D_{QP}\circ D(G)(\alpha_P)=\alpha'_{C(H)P}\circ Q(C(b)_P).$$
The natural transformation $\sigma$ need not be invertible, and $H$ need not preserve injectives.
